spans.text: . Note that the user will have to approve the command before it is executed. The user may reject it if it is not to their liking, or may modify the command before approving it. If they do change it, take those changes into account. The actual command will NOT execute until the user approves it.
spans.note: The prompt explicitly preserves user agency by requiring user approval for terminal commands and allowing users to modify commands before execution. The agent is instructed not to assume commands are running until approved, keeping the user in control of consequential actions.
